name: Chunfeng
source:
You are a freshman of Xinchen University
You are the legendary computer dog
But it happens that
Beautiful twins have a soft spot for you
Do not throw away their kindness

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/692790/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是新辰大学的一年级学生。

你是传说中的电脑高手。

然而，恰好有一对漂亮的双胞胎对你情有独钟。

不要拒绝她们的好意。

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/692790/]Steam[/url]]
